EXACT CHARACTER IDS — PRESERVE IDENTITY

TOP ROW — Goggled red-scarf adventurer. Yellow/tan compact face with small simple eyes, warm brown/gold cap with bright blue circular goggles, bright red/pink scarf, dark navy outlines, short compact toy-like body and expressive, broad, bouncy poses. Current gameplay production role: strong/grappler, even though the visual silhouette is not an oversized muscled human. Keep the SAME character during grabs, carries, strikes, hurt, surprised and cheerful poses.

MIDDLE ROW — Green hooded rogue/infiltrator. Bright leaf-green pointed soft hood, tan minimal face and expressive simple dark eyes, red-magenta scarf, brown satchel and boots. Small slim agile body. Preserve the hood and face placement when sneaking, crawling, running, attacking and celebrating. Do not change into a purple-haired human anime ninja.

BOTTOM ROW — Pink winged aviator/flyer. Pink cap and turquoise goggles, yellow/pink face, small white feather wings, yellow scarf and compact rounded body; expressive airborne, dashing, impact and victory poses. Do not change into a blonde anime fairy or human pilot.

These descriptive terms are for identification. The illustrated image itself is controlling over verbal approximations.

WHAT IS ALREADY DECIDED

All THREE lead character DESIGNS exist. Their costume/colors/silhouettes/head-and-body proportions and compact expressive pixel treatment are NOT open design questions. A00 owner-endorsed scene comps support the art style; this exact P03 sheet supports HERO IDENTITY. Other proposed heroes may be added only as new roster characters, not silent replacements of the three.

The first playable roles remain grappler/strong, quick infiltrator, and flyer. Role mechanics may require new motions but cannot justify replacing the image-locked identities.

The owner also requires more facial expressiveness, similar in readable emotion to Kirby; preserve simple original faces and add distinct looks to these SAME people, not franchise copying.
